title: Phoenix NPU PQC: 100% On-Device Post-Quantum Cryptography on AMD Phoenix NPU
description: World's first complete, 100% device-resident hardware implementation of the finalized NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography standards (FIPS 202 SHA-3/SHAKE, FIPS 203 ML-KEM, and FIPS 204 ML-DSA) on the AMD Phoenix NPU (Ryzen 7 7840HS / Ryzen 9 7940HS w/ AIE2 / XDNA1 Architecture). Validated across 19 physical silicon gates (736/736 test cases PASS in 23.98s) with zero host CPU cryptographic fallback.
